name: בלק"ר - פרסום מודעה בקבוצות
description: מפרסם את מודעת הרכב שלכם מלוח בלק"ר בקבוצות הפייסבוק שאתם חברים בהן, מהחשבון שלכם.
_permissions_note: No 'tabs' permission on purpose. tabs.create/remove/sendMessage do not need it - it only gates reading a tab's url, title and favIconUrl, which this never does - and asking for it makes Chrome tell every installer 'Read your browsing history', which is both alarming and untrue of what this does.

content_scripts.//: The page-to-extension relay. localhost is here so the site half can be developed against the dev server - externally_connectable cannot match it, which is why this is a content script rather than that.
